summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by Pieria — by lot the bride of Idmon son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus by Gorgo married the Pieria maidens at Argos; distinct from Idmon the Argonaut seer son of Apollo.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Pylarge sixth and last among the daughters of Danaus borne on Pieria. When the sons of Egyptus by Gorgo cast lots for the Pieria maidens, Idmon drew Pylarge — a namesake only of Idmon the augur who sailed with Jason. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom.
